sources.snippet: PyTorch toolkit for the VisDrone aerial detection dataset. Supports 33 models (4 torchvision + 29 YOLO), end-to-end training, evaluation, and inference. Example: YOLO26x predictions on VisDrone video sequences using Soft-NMS (confidence threshold = 0.5).
